d: What happens if you take fake steroids for 100 days while believing they’re the real thing? Ray had been lifting for more than a decade and was convinced he needed steroids to build the body he wanted. For the next 100 days, Ray followed a science-based training and nutrition plan while believing he was enhanced. What looked like a steroid transformation was actually a natural bodybuilding experiment and gym transformation — tracked with DXA scans, blood work, and strength tests to see whether the steroid placebo effect could influence performance.
